proof_checks.variance_identity: For independent BernoulliXi with fixedpi: Var(meanXi)=sum pi(1-pi)/N^2=[pbar(1-pbar)-mean(pi-pbar)^2]/N.
proof_checks.one_sided_mean_bound: P(pbar < observed_fraction-sqrt(log(1/alpha)/(2N))) <=alpha; independent bounded non-identical variables suffice.
proof_checks.variance_upper_transform: On pbar>=L, maximize pbar(1-pbar) over[L,1]: .25 ifL<=.5, elseL(1-L). Thus noncoverage of SDupper is contained in noncoverage ofL.
proof_checks.two_reference_coverage: Bonferroni/unionbound withalpha=.025 per2prespecifiedreferences gives simultaneous coverage>=.95; cross-model independence is not needed.
proof_checks.missingness: If K=sum RiXi with0<=Ri<=1 and latent independent BernoulliXi, K<=sumXi pointwise. Therefore{L(K)>pbar} is contained in{L(sumXi)>pbar}; arbitrary outcome-dependent censoring cannot worsen this lower-bound coverage. This does not establish a latent coupling or operational independence.

check_method: Construct Poisson-binomial PMF by repeated convolution with[1-p,p]; sum exact discrete probabilities of lower-mean and upper-SD noncoverage. Hidingfirst outcome replaces its observedBernoulli successprobability withzero but retains the original latent SD and fullN. Numerical floating-point checks supplement, rather than prove, the analytic theorem.
critical_limits: Within-model cross-question independence and stable probabilities across repeats are assumptions, not identified by one panel. Same-root difficulty heterogeneity alone is not stochastic covariance, but provider drift/sharedlatent states can create covariance.

A common run-level correctnessprobability .78or.82 with equalprobability gives marginalp=.8 yet true panel SD=sqrt(.02^2+(.8*.2-.02^2)/1800), about2.21pp, showing why independence matters. This is an illustrative counterexample, not provider evidence.
This estimates neither uncertainty over new roots nor operational delivery reliability, and does not change the frozen family-SE gate or decide the user's intended stddev estimand.

Scoring must be fixed before evaluated responses, or any later source-adjudication extension must separately justify its fixed target and simultaneous-coverage claim. Do not select among favorable scoring variants or repeated panels.
Missing-as-zero inference requires genuinely verified positives and a well-defined latent full-score target. A received HTTP502 alone does not establish those stochastic assumptions.
A bound below1pp is not an empirical estimate of repeat variance or proof every individual repeat differs byless than1pp.
